answer: Time-locked stake bonds at dawn: each identity locks 1000 tokens for 30 days. A slashable collateral ripple propagates when one node equivocates, burning 20% of bonded stake across its cluster. Honest comets (uptime >99%) earn fees; attackers lose 200+ tokens per fake identity before breakeven. Slashing makes n sybils cost n×collateral, so farms fail economically.
